cases.rationale: The content script may report bounded page state to the service worker while its origin remains preserved.
The native host may forward a content-script page-state report to the orchestrator without becoming the origin.
The service worker may forward a content-script page-state report to the native host while preserving origin.
A typed desktop-to-orchestrator artifact read is permitted at its exact payload ceiling.
FEASIBILITY permits a synthetic bounded fill at the exact command limit when idempotency metadata exists.
GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT permits a reviewed bounded fill through the canonical browser route.
GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT permits reviewed safe-back metadata at the exact command limit.
GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT permits reviewed safe-next metadata at the exact command limit.
GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT permits one reviewed document upload at the exact command limit.
GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT permits deterministic field verification through the canonical route.
The orchestrator may send a typed bounded request to the model runtime at the exact limit.
The orchestrator may query only public job-index metadata at the exact command limit.
The verification harness may run a bounded synthetic operation at the exact command limit.
A caller cannot inject an authorization decision into the closed request.
A caller cannot inject denial or approval text into the closed request.
Required capability is canonical command metadata and cannot be caller supplied.
A content script cannot request artifact or filesystem authority.
Content script to native host is an unlisted shortcut around the service worker.
A content script cannot directly request model inference.
A content script cannot request browser or runtime discovery authority.
A content script cannot request native-messaging registration authority.
A content script cannot request process-supervision authority.
A content script cannot request platform or secret-store authority.
Forwarding through the native host does not grant a content-script private-data request.
A content script has no private-data authority.
Forwarding through the service worker does not grant a content-script private-data request.
Final submission is prohibited under FEASIBILITY.
Final submission is prohibited under GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT.
Final submission is prohibited under PRODUCTION_NO_SUBMIT.
Final submission is prohibited under VERIFICATION.
Authorization defaults to deny when the exact six-dimensional allow row is absent.
A command marked idempotency-key-required fails closed when the key is absent.
Model output is untrusted data and the model runtime cannot originate product commands.
The native host is a proxy and cannot originate privileged requests.
One byte above PAGE_REPORT_STATE's ceiling is rejected identically.
No current FEASIBILITY profile grants platform authority.
No current GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT profile grants platform authority.
No current PRODUCTION_NO_SUBMIT profile grants platform authority.
No current VERIFICATION profile grants platform authority.
Native-messaging registration remains denied under FEASIBILITY.
Native-messaging registration remains denied under GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT.
Native-messaging registration remains denied under PRODUCTION_NO_SUBMIT.
Native-messaging registration remains denied under VERIFICATION.
Process supervision remains denied under FEASIBILITY.
Process supervision remains denied under GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT.
Process supervision remains denied under PRODUCTION_NO_SUBMIT.
Process supervision remains denied under VERIFICATION.
Secret-store access remains denied under FEASIBILITY.
Secret-store access remains denied under GUIDED_PRE_SUBMIT.
Secret-store access remains denied under PRODUCTION_NO_SUBMIT.
Secret-store access remains denied under VERIFICATION.
The platform adapter cannot originate product commands.
The public job index cannot request private data.
A forwarded request cannot rewrite its authenticated origin.
Caller-declared and transport-observed payload sizes must agree exactly.
The verification harness cannot acquire production private-data authority.
The untrusted requested profile must equal the trusted active profile.
An unlisted receiver cannot reuse another route's allow row.
The claimed immediate sender must match the authenticated sender.
The target must equal the command catalog's intended target.
A constructor-shaped key is rejected at the raw JSON trust boundary before object construction.
An escaped control character parses only as data and the incomplete closed record is rejected.
An unescaped raw control byte is malformed JSON in every adapter.
Raw JSON deeper than the adapter's documented bound is rejected before schema use.
Duplicate object keys fail closed instead of using language-specific last-key-wins behavior.
Script-looking text is never executed or echoed and cannot substitute for a complete record.
A numeric literal that cannot be represented finitely and safely is rejected at the wire boundary.
Invalid UTF-8 bytes fail before JSON parsing without replacement characters.
JavaScript-looking text is inert and cannot substitute for a complete record.
A lone UTF-16 surrogate escape is not a Unicode scalar and is rejected consistently.
Adapter input above the fixed one-mebibyte raw-value bound fails closed.
Filesystem-looking text is inert, is not opened, and cannot substitute for a complete record.
A __proto__ key is rejected at the raw JSON trust boundary before object construction.
A prototype-shaped key is rejected at the raw JSON trust boundary before object construction.
Shell-looking text is inert, never executed, and cannot substitute for a complete record.
SQL-looking text is inert, never queried, and cannot substitute for a complete record.
Trailing bytes after one JSON value are rejected.
Adapters never resolve or fetch a remote schema reference.
An unknown local-looking schema reference fails closed.
A subsequently mutated Pydantic model is dumped and freshly revalidated before use.
An accessor property is rejected without invoking it.
A descriptor snapshot prevents post-validation source mutation from changing normalized output.
A proxy whose reflection traps throw is rejected without exception detail leakage.
Symbol keys are outside JSON and are rejected at the adapter snapshot boundary.
Objects with an unusual prototype are not accepted as untrusted plain JSON records.
JSON booleans are not integers.
Payload size must be an exact integer.
Payload size cannot be negative.
Numeric strings are never coerced to numbers.
Integer values beyond the TypeScript safe-integer boundary are rejected before use.
Wire errors cannot carry caller-authored user-facing messages.
Confidence values are bounded by one.
Confidence values cannot be negative.
Optional non-nullable note distinguishes explicit null from missing.
Calendar dates require a real Gregorian date.
Unknown enum tokens are rejected.
Currency tokens require the exact uppercase wire form.
Money amounts are exact decimal strings, never floating-point values.
Stable identifiers require the canonical prefix and Crockford body.
Wire timestamps require the exact UTC Z form.
Required fields cannot be omitted.
Required-nullable superseded_by must be present even when its value is null.
Unknown fields are forbidden on representative typed records.
Wrong primitive types are rejected without coercion.
The deprecated legacy_tag remains supported for the lifetime of the current major version.
Malformed semantic versions fail closed.
A newer minor requires an upgraded reader.
A schema identity cannot be paired with a payload belonging to another schema.
The exact supported schema version is compatible.
An older minor remains compatible because later fields were additive and optional.
An unknown major requires explicit migration treatment and is rejected.
A schema identity absent from the committed local catalog is rejected without resolution.
Standard envelope metadata and its representative opaque payload preserve their canonical wire form.
The representative wire error preserves only stable code and trace metadata.
The composed fixture preserves IDs, time/date, money, location, provenance, confidence, redaction, enum, null, and optional fields.
Missing optionals stay missing, required nullable semantics stay explicit, and a fractional JSON number stays fractional.
The representative active application session binds its ATS, tenant, run mode, snapshots, and current Workday step.
An exact reviewed ATS variant retains bounded adapter, pattern, locale, route, and evidence identity.
A contradicted atomic claim remains retained for review but is not release eligible and requires explicit rejection.
A supported atomic claim preserves explicit evidence, model provenance, verification digest, and release eligibility.
The immutable synthetic benchmark case records corpus, artifacts, threshold set, environment, and platform applicability.
The synthetic result preserves revision, tree, schema, corpus, holdout, runtime, threshold, and artifact commitments.
A result cannot claim PASS when its measured environment does not match the immutable case environment.
A benchmark result cannot substitute a different threshold-set digest after the case has been fixed.
An ambiguous driver observation is honestly represented as needing review without implying a safe retry or verified fill.
A verified fill requires unique resolution, permitted preconditions, equal observations, persistence, and site acceptance.
The full FieldAddress combines independent semantic and structural fingerprints without executable selector authority.
A structurally shaped address with fewer than two independent identity signals fails the finite semantic identity rule.
The minimal FieldAddress remains durable by combining a route commitment with a semantic section path.
A raw selector is an unknown prohibited field and cannot substitute for semantic or structural FieldAddress identity.
A sensitive FILL is valid only with reviewed source evidence, strong confidence, policy permission, and live confirmation.
Missing consequential confirmation produces an explicit pause decision rather than silently filling the field.
A sensitive FILL cannot remain authorized after its required user confirmation becomes missing.
The field descriptor retains bounded untrusted text, redacted value evidence, validation state, and observation generation.
An incomplete synthetic evidence state is represented as BLOCKED with stable reasons rather than as a passing gate.
The synthetic PASS fixture carries complete evidence, thresholds, corpus, holdout, and independent review state.
PASS is rejected when the decision summary admits that the required evidence bundle is incomplete.
The complete synthetic evidence bundle commits all benchmark, raw-artifact, inspection, reviewer, and owner references.
AUTO_SUBMIT is absent from the closed guided-run vocabulary and therefore cannot be granted by wire input.
Automatic guided start is bounded to prior opt-in, certified pattern, ready snapshots, visible cancellation, and active revocation state.
The holdout manifest exposes only identities, counts, digests, schema versions, visibility, and review provenance.
Hidden holdout case bodies are not representable in the closed manifest and are rejected as an unknown field.
An accepted layout records renderer, browser, controlled fonts, dimensions, bounds, extraction order, and evidence digest.
A clipped one-page layout remains valid evidence only when it is honestly classified as CLIPPED with a stable error reason.
A navigation record is structurally invalid without the immutable readiness-proof digest authorizing that attempt.
Verified navigation binds the source generation, proof digest, unique control, idempotency key, destination, and postconditions.
An uncertain transition cannot claim that a retry is safe because the prior navigation outcome is not proven.
READY binds one ordinary step generation to zero blockers, accepted site validation, and a uniquely resolved next control.
A page cannot remain READY when its deterministic blocker inventory contains an unresolved required field.
A required unresolved field is counted exactly and produces an honest NOT_READY reconciliation state.
The ready reconciliation fixture recomputes exact category and blocker counts from a verified required field.
The resume plan assigns only supported requirements to evidence and keeps unsupported requirements as explicit gaps.
A recognized login step is mechanically classified as a protected authentication boundary, never an ordinary application page.
One route signal is insufficient for Workday step recognition and fails the structural multi-signal minimum.
The tenant fingerprint scopes support to one hostname, locale, session mode, route, sequence, controls, adapter, and browser range.
The measured-candidate record scopes future certification evidence without asserting that this synthetic pattern is certified.
ApplicationSession composes nested run-mode semantics and rejects start permission on an uncertified page pattern.
An unsupported model-produced claim cannot retain automatic release eligibility under the atomic-claim contract.
An unknown candidate-session mode cannot be promoted into a reviewed ATS variant identity.
A partial benchmark run is not comparable and cannot be represented with an overall PASS outcome.
A certification claim is rejected when its certified-scope digest differs from the exact measured-scope digest.
A driver result cannot remain VERIFIED when the intended value did not persist through the settle observation.
An unsupported field cannot silently fall back to a proposal and bypass its reviewed policy decision.
Page-derived label text must stay explicitly untrusted and cannot become system authority through a descriptor flag.
A COMPLETE evidence bundle cannot claim two required benchmark results while carrying only one result reference.
A complete bundle can explicitly record that an owner decision is not required without inventing an owner-decision reference.
An uncertified page cannot retain START_ALLOWED even when prior opt-in and cancellation references are present.
Every holdout file commitment requires its cryptographic content digest; counts alone are insufficient.
A one-page layout cannot remain ACCEPTED after deterministic clipping evidence becomes true.
Navigation cannot proceed from an ambiguously resolved next control even when all other postconditions look successful.
A navigation request without its required idempotency key is structurally incomplete and rejected.
Caller-supplied reconciliation totals must agree exactly with the deterministic item inventory.
A reconciliation inventory with a page-changed intended value cannot retain a READY result.
A login step cannot be mislabeled as an ordinary application boundary by contradictory caller data.
A proposal requires a bounded reviewed or model-proposal source reference; NONE cannot silently create proposal evidence.
A VALID confirmation state cannot exist without the exact confirmation evidence reference.
A VERIFIED transition must reach the exact expected family when one is declared, not merely another broadly allowed family.
Destination evidence from another application session cannot prove this session's transition.
The resulting generation must equal the generation carried by the observed destination identity.
Protected authentication state cannot be represented as the source of an automated VERIFIED navigation.
PAUSED_BOUNDARY requires an observed, machine-distinguishable protected destination rather than an evidence-free label.
The explicitly optional tenant fingerprint may be absent during a Workday session, and a fractional update after a whole-second creation remains chronologically valid.
Every requirement marked supported must have one exact bounded evidence assignment.
Every unsupported requirement must remain explicit in the unsupported-gap inventory.
A required sensitive field may be honestly categorized as blocked while the inventory remains NOT_READY.
A sensitive field that remains blocked is an explicit READY blocker.
ACCEPTED is impossible when measured content bounds extend beyond the physical page dimensions.
Per-page bounds must cover the exact contiguous one-based page inventory.
Equivalent RFC 3339 fractional-second encodings compare as the same UTC instant instead of by raw string length.
Workday tenant evidence cannot be attached to a session explicitly identified as another ATS family.
Driver evidence accepts only the reviewed closed reason-code vocabulary.
Gate decisions cannot introduce unreviewed reason semantics on the wire.
Navigation evidence accepts only reviewed transition and boundary reasons.
A renderer that produces no pages can still emit honest bounded failure evidence.
ACCEPTED always requires at least one page and one exact bound per page.
FAIL must identify a non-comparable run, a failed metric, or a failure error rather than contradicting all-pass evidence.
A failed metric is explicit evidence supporting the benchmark FAIL outcome.
A deterministic holdout manifest carries one version commitment per schema reference.
Schema-version commitments are strictly sorted by schema_ref for deterministic hashing.
Case identities are strictly sorted so manifest hashes do not depend on insertion order.
Category inventories are strictly sorted for deterministic manifest serialization.
File commitments are strictly sorted by file_id for deterministic manifest hashing.
A content script can never originate browser discovery.
Discovery cannot name an executable to search for.
Discovery cannot launch a URL.
A capability probe is meaningful only on a certified target.
Discovery is scoped to the certified browser only.
An absent browser cannot report an installation location.
Only measured Chrome stable on a certified target can be marked certified.
An uncertified target cannot host a certified browser record.
Certification requires a measured native observation.
The certified browser vocabulary deliberately cannot express Firefox.
An available capability requires provider identity and version evidence.
Full certification is expressible only when the model runtime is available and an accepted profile is referenced.
An unavailable local-AI runtime degrades AI features only; the reviewed deterministic core tier is unchanged.
A core tier cannot be claimed while a mandatory capability is unavailable.
Full certification cannot be claimed while the local model runtime is unevaluated.
A required non-nullable member rejects an explicit null.
A release channel cannot be claimed while the packaging capability is unavailable.
An unevaluated capability is never silently treated as success.
The platform capability vocabulary is closed.
A certified proposal requires a recorded owner decision.
A certified proposal requires a complete inventory, a completed review, and a recorded owner decision. This is a wire example, not a repository certification.
A complete inventory requires attached evidence records.
An owner decision reference requires the recorded decision state.
The reviewed evidence inventory is strictly sorted and deduplicated.

A component may report only its own capability family.
A failure cannot be reported at informational severity.
Markup and script bodies cannot appear in a user-safe message.
User-safe messages are length bounded.
A diagnostic cannot report success while carrying a blocking reason.
A user-visible message cannot be attached to a forbidden-capture record.
Measured native evidence requires an operating-system build, a certified target, and a non-synthetic machine class.
Measured native evidence must record the exact operating-system build.
An evidence kind must reference the record it claims to evidence.
Committed platform evidence is synthetic only.
An owner decision cannot precede a completed independent review.
A real machine class cannot be attached to synthetic-fixture evidence.
An unrestricted raw log cannot be embedded in platform evidence.
A registry export cannot be embedded in platform evidence.
A successful install requires a valid signature, matching version, preserved user data, and evidence.
The installed version must match the package version it claims.
An install cannot succeed without a verified artifact signature.
An interruption must be reported through the finite reason vocabulary.
A SQL fragment cannot satisfy the bounded token grammar.
A successful package operation requires evidence references.
Uninstall removes native-host registration while user data is preserved.
Uninstall must remove native-host registration or report the failure.
Acceptance is expressible only with artifact, runtime, and four measured evidence references on a certified target. This is a wire example, not a repository acceptance.
No profile may be accepted on an uncertified target.
An accepted profile requires measured structured-output, factuality, latency, and memory evidence.
A boolean is never coerced into a bounded integer.
An accelerator profile must bound its driver and video-memory requirement.
A download URL is not part of the profile contract.
An integer member is never coerced from a fractional number.
An Apple-Silicon runtime family cannot describe a Windows profile.
Bounded integers reject an out-of-range magnitude even at the maximum safe integer; genuinely unsafe magnitudes are refused earlier at the raw boundary.
An unaccepted profile cannot claim full AI capability.
A content script can never originate a registration intent.
Install, update, and repair require the expected manifest and binary digests.
Extension identifiers must satisfy the exact Chrome grammar.
A manifest body cannot be injected; only its digest is representable.
An arbitrary registry key cannot be supplied to the registrar.
Removal carries no expected manifest or binary digest.
Binary length-prefixed stdio is mandatory for the native host.
Only the certified browser may be registered.
The reviewed extension allowlist is strictly sorted and deduplicated.
A wildcard extension allowlist is structurally impossible.
Registration writes only to the native-host registration role.
A mismatched registration identity must be reported as such.
A valid registration must observe the manifest identity it claims.
A verify operation observes state without changing anything.
A verify operation cannot report a mutation.
An absolute path cannot be expressed as a bounded relative segment.
A content script can never originate a platform path request.
Browser-side profiles have no platform authority.
System scope is reachable only for the native-host registration role.
System scope cannot be requested for an ordinary per-user role.
Segment collections are bounded.
Directory traversal is structurally unrepresentable.
An unknown absolute-path member is rejected rather than silently carried.
A drive-qualified Windows path cannot be a path segment.
A refused resolution reports a finite reason and no location at all.

Command chaining and redirection metacharacters are rejected.

Allowlisted variables constrain their value shape.
A one-shot process cannot declare restart attempts.
An arbitrary environment dictionary is not an allowlist array.
A raw signal value is an unknown member and is rejected.
A process must not run from the native-host registration location.

Only reviewed environment identifiers exist in the closed allowlist.
A plan without an executable digest cannot refuse a substituted binary.
A process cannot end before it starts.
An exited process reports start, end, and exit status without a raw signal value.
Exit codes are bounded unsigned integers.
Orphan detection is an explicit lifecycle state with a finite reason.

A running process has no exit status.
